methods.matte: Frozen extract with edge_mode=clamp, preserve_particles=True; 12-px pure-green padding in RAM then exact crop; Euclidean mask dilation radius 6 px.
methods.seams: Every prior rectangle overlap: DP +/-1; transparent path cost zero; opaque path costs reported; corner orientation and conflicting overlap selected by lower path mean cost; +/-3 px feather; sole nonzero-alpha source wins.
methods.noise: Seed 7 PCG64 uniform control grids; cubic interpolation at wavelengths 420/210/105, amplitudes 1/.5/.25; summed field min-max normalized.
methods.eligibility: Any DEEP in rows y-400..y-1 and columns x-64..x+64; blur sigma 48 applied to this eligibility field across full canvas.
methods.texture: Separable linear full-overlap windows, normalized weighted sum; odd rows include negative-column tile to cover left canvas edge.

b_shallow_rgb_change.domain: all depth < 6000 pixels; straight RGB of delivered final versus base before atmosphere

d_void_extent_below_face_bottom_px.definition: Distance to farthest void pixel with cloud alpha >= 0.5 below bottom-most FACE pixel in each face-containing column; zero if none.

d1_shallow_nearest_face_cloud_spill.definition: Cloud alpha >= 0.1, nearest FACE depth <= 6000 mm, and Euclidean nearest-DEEP distance > 400 px; all canvas pixels.

d2_straight_alpha_edges.definition: Maximal runs at a fixed high-side pixel coordinate, scanning both polarities; one-/two-pixel detections deduplicated at high endpoint.
